svg.title: estate-atlas: architecture as checked data (animated)
svg.desc: Animated loop with the shop example: claims in atlas.json are checked one by one against git, and one drift is reported. Journal and event records are projected onto the flows as pulses with volume counts, a silent live flow blinks, and a record that crosses no flow is flagged. explain prints a plain-English sentence from facts, and tour with a public overlay rewrites internal names and passes the leak check.
svg.text: check claims against git · route real events onto flows · explain from facts · public tour with leak check

g.text: "worker takes jobs from api over the
orders contract and writes to db."
no private names in the public tour

svg.text: You describe components, contracts and flows. check proves each claim against git
One claim drifted from the code, and the check says so
route projects real journal and event records onto the flows
A live flow went silent, and records that cross no flow are counted
tour rewrites internal names into public wording…
…with total coverage and a leak check
explain describes any component in plain words, from facts only
